The implementer reported DONE, so I run the task's tests myself before any review. I run the brief's passing command (Step 4) and the project's documented test command (`make test`, from the README) in one call. I leave out Step 2 because it is expected to fail.

<command>
cd /work/recipes && ~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/test-run specs/plans/4-metric-units.md 2 -- sh -c 'uv run pytest tests/test_units.py -q -rs && make test'
</command>

I make no file edits and send no message to my partner before this run. I write the ledger line only after the review comes back clean.

**If the run exits non-zero:** I skip the review and start a fix round. The run file's path is the finding. I follow fix-loop.md and the round counts toward the five-attempt cap.

**If the run passes**, I do the following, in order:

1. Generate the review package with the BASE I recorded before dispatch. I take the path out of the `wrote <path>: ...` line.

<command>
cd /work/recipes && ~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/review-package specs/plans/4-metric-units.md 3f9c2a1 8e41b07
</command>

2. Dispatch the task reviewer from `task-reviewer-prompt.md` at `sonnet`. The diff is small and mechanical, and reviews floor at standard. The prompt contains only these:
   - the brief path,
   - `/work/recipes/.sdd/4-metric-units/task-2-report.md`,
   - the run file path alone, as `[RUN_FILE]`,
   - the review-package path alone,
   - the plan's Global Constraints copied verbatim, plus Task 2's binding values (236.588 mL per US cup, `cups_to_ml(cups: float) -> int`, rounded to a whole millilitre).

   It has no "do not flag" language and no request to re-run tests.

3. Handle the verdict. If both the spec and quality verdicts are clean, I append `Task 2: complete (commits 3f9c2a1..8e41b07, review clean)` to `/work/recipes/.sdd/4-metric-units/progress.md` and move to Task 3 without checking in. If there are Critical or Important findings, I re-read fix-loop.md and dispatch a fix subagent. A ⚠️ item gets resolved per cannot-verify.md before I mark the task complete.
